name: Gregor Cornish
original_name: グレゴール・コーニッシュ
source:
The serious bishop of the Health Department, and a doctor. Rather stoic but with a good nature nonetheless, he always smells like cigarettes.

There's some rumors that he has a relationship with [url=https://vndb.org/c103280]Grette[/url] going around the temple...
